title: A session that never advances freezes the run (denial of service)
status: blocked by the gateway's pause deadline (turn cap max_calls_per_pause; wall-clock pause_wall_s backstop)
notes: Every pause parks the simulator until the pausing agent advances, so one client that keeps calling tools (or goes quiet) without advancing freezes every other agent.

Blocked: past max_calls_per_pause the pause is missed (pause_deadline_missed, queued sends discarded, the sim resumes); pause_wall_s does the same on the wall clock for a client that goes quiet. The agent then counts as silent for that gate (D78 silent_reference where the run sets it).
